description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
MEP Manager
  
Project and Development Services – India
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
Being the go-to MEP person
  
Are you considered to be the go-to person for all MEP matters? That’s what you’ll be in this role. You’ll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. Your task is to fully understand, collect and deliver clients’ MEP requirements. The design manager in MEP will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You’ll also assist the contract manager in MEP-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in MEP-related installation, site inspection and contractor management.
  
  
Making visions come true
  
You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there.
  
  
While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project.
  
  
Building strong teams and business reputation
  
One of your priorities will be to produce high-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities.
  
  
Keeping risks at bay
  
How do you deal with risks? You’ll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health & safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**  
An MEP pro
  
You have a degree in MEP engineering-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc.
  
  
Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP-related management—including the development of MEP project plan and procedures and construction schedules? Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let’s talk.
  
  
A business savvy leader who can walk the talk
  
You understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You’re also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements.
  
  
You’ll back up your business know-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You’ll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders.
  
  
A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skills
  
Are you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You’ll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results-oriented leader with good problem-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients.
  
  
**What we can do for you:**  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Growth Marketer
description:
**About Snaphomz**  
Snaphomz is an AI-first PropTech platform helping people discover, evaluate, and navigate real estate decisions in the United States. We combine AI, data, and practical tools to make the homebuying experience more transparent and accessible.

**The Opportunity**  
We are hiring an energetic, resourceful, results-obsessed Growth Marketing Lead who can turn bold ideas into measurable acquisition, engagement, and conversion. You will work closely with the founder and leadership team, guide execution with our India-based marketing team, and build growth programs for U.S. audiences. This is a hands-on player-coach role: you will research, pitch, test, launch, measure, and improve—not simply assign tasks or report activity.

**What You Will Own**  
**U.S. audience insights, content and viral ideas**  
· Research U.S. homebuyer pain points, social conversations, creator trends, emerging formats, competitor positioning, and regional opportunities; translate insights into weekly campaign ideas.  
· Develop distinctive, culturally relevant content concepts, social hooks, short-form video briefs, UGC campaigns, community activations, referral loops, and responsible guerrilla/growth experiments.  
· Build an experimentation backlog; define hypotheses, target audiences, success criteria, owners, budgets, and deadlines for each test.  
**Organic, social and community growth**  
· Grow relevant audiences and qualified website traffic through SEO, content distribution, social channels, creator partnerships, community participation, and partnerships.  
· Coordinate content calendars and execution across platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, and Reddit where audience fit is demonstrated.  
· Prioritize engagement quality, sign-ups, qualified leads, and activated users—not follower counts or impressions in isolation.  
**Paid acquisition and conversion**  
· Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns on Meta, Google, TikTok, and other appropriate channels; manage targeting, creatives, landing pages, budgets, and testing.  
· Track spend, attribution, funnel conversion, cost per qualified lead, customer acquisition cost, and return on spend where measurable; reallocate budget based on evidence.  
· Partner with product and design teams to improve landing pages, onboarding, activation, retargeting, and A/B testing.  
**Email and lifecycle marketing**  
· Own email strategy across acquisition, onboarding, nurturing, re-engagement, and conversion, including segmentation, personalization, automation, and testing.  
· Monitor deliverability, list quality, open/click trends, replies, qualified actions, and downstream conversion; improve campaigns based on cohort performance.  
**Team execution and leadership**  
· Work directly with founders and leadership to convert business priorities into weekly growth plans, clear briefs, owners, milestones, and measurable deliverables.  
· Coordinate and oversee day-to-day delivery with the India-based marketing team, including content, creatives, campaigns, SEO, email, and reporting; provide constructive feedback and remove blockers.  
· Lead weekly growth reviews: share what launched, what worked, what failed, learnings, next experiments, and decisions required.  
· Use AI and automation tools thoughtfully to speed up research, production, workflows, and analysis while ensuring accuracy and brand quality.

**What We Are Looking For**  
· 2–5 years in growth, digital, or performance marketing, with evidence of campaigns you personally drove and their measurable outcomes.  
· Practical knowledge of U.S. consumer audiences, social trends, messaging, and channel dynamics; ability to research local market differences.  
· Hands-on competence in Meta/Google advertising, SEO/content distribution, email automation, analytics, attribution, and conversion-rate optimization.  
· Working familiarity with GA4, Search Console, Tag Manager, ad managers, CRM/email platforms, and reporting dashboards.  
· A strong creative instinct paired with analytical rigor: you can pitch unconventional ideas and validate them with disciplined experiments.  
· Excellent English communication, cross-functional coordination, prioritization, and the confidence to challenge weak ideas with evidence.  
· High ownership, speed, curiosity, resilience, and willingness to execute personally in a fast-moving startup.

**Nice to Have**  
· Experience in U.S. real estate, PropTech, consumer technology, SaaS, or marketplaces.  
· Track record of creator/influencer partnerships, viral campaigns, referral growth, and community-led acquisition.  
· Experience guiding a small marketing team or coordinating agencies and freelancers.  
· Knowledge of AI-powered marketing workflows and U.S. housing advertising compliance.

**How Success Will Be Measured**  
· Growth in qualified U.S. sign-ups, activated users, leads, and attributable conversions.  
· Sustainable organic search and social growth, with measurable contribution to acquisition.  
· Paid campaign efficiency: qualified lead cost, acquisition cost, conversion rate, and budget discipline.  
· Email-driven engagement, activation, reactivation, and conversions.  
· Speed and quality of experiments launched, learnings applied, and team delivery against agreed priorities.

**Compensation and Performance Bonus**  
Competitive compensation based on experience and demonstrated ability, plus eligibility for a performance-based bonus. Bonus goals, measurement windows, attribution rules, payout timing, and eligibility conditions will be agreed in writing. Awards may reflect qualified organic/channel growth, attributable conversions, effective paid campaign management, and overall growth impact. A bonus is not guaranteed solely for increased followers, impressions, or ad spend.

**Why Join Snaphomz?**  
Work closely with leadership, influence growth strategy, own meaningful campaigns end to end, and help build an AI-first product for the U.S. real estate market. We value initiative, experimentation, accountability, and visible results.

title: Principal ServiceNow Architect – ITSM & Enterprise Workflow
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Principal ServiceNow Architect to lead the architecture, solution design, technical governance, and implementation of scalable ServiceNow solutions. The individual will be responsible for translating business and IT requirements into secure, maintainable, and upgrade-friendly platform capabilities aligned with ITIL best practices and enterprise architecture standards.

The role requires a strong combination of ServiceNow platform expertise, hands-on technical proficiency, ITSM process knowledge, integration architecture, and stakeholder management. The candidate must be capable of independently handling complex technical challenges, evaluating existing implementations, identifying architectural gaps, and driving solutions from design through deployment and operational support.

The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, ITSM process owners, platform administrators, developers, integration teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and delivery leadership.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise and Solution Architecture**

Define the ServiceNow platform architecture, technical standards, design principles, and implementation guidelines.

Translate business requirements and functional specifications into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions.

Lead architecture assessments, solution design reviews, technical feasibility assessments, and architectural decision-making.

Evaluate out-of-the-box capabilities against customization requirements and prioritize configuration over custom development wherever feasible.

Define reusable architectural patterns, application boundaries, data models, and integration approaches.

Maintain architecture documentation, solution design documents, technical specifications, and architecture decision records.

Assess existing implementations to identify technical debt, architectural inconsistencies, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. ITSM and ITIL Process Architecture**

Design and govern ServiceNow ITSM capabilities, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Request Management, Knowledge Management, and Service Catalog.

Align platform workflows with ITIL 4 principles and enterprise service management policies.

Review and optimize incident categorization, impact, urgency, priority, assignment rules, escalation, and SLA management.

Define appropriate priority calculation and escalation models, ensuring that business impact and urgency drive consistent prioritization.

Establish standards for incident lifecycle management, major incident handling, problem investigation, change risk assessment, approvals, and service restoration.

Ensure that process implementations are consistent, measurable, auditable, and aligned with operational objectives.

Challenge unnecessary customizations or process variations that increase complexity without delivering measurable business value.

**3. Technical Architecture and Advanced Development**

Provide technical leadership for complex ServiceNow implementations, custom applications, workflows, and platform enhancements.

Demonstrate strong hands-on knowledge of JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAggregate, GlideSystem, GlideAjax, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Flow Designer.

Design and troubleshoot advanced automation, event-driven processing, asynchronous operations, and complex workflow logic.

Define appropriate use of IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, scripting, scheduled jobs, events, and platform-native capabilities.

Review code for quality, security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and compliance with ServiceNow development standards.

Diagnose complex defects, production incidents, transaction failures, slow-running scripts, and unexpected platform behavior.

Establish development standards, code review practices, reusable components, and technical documentation.

**4. Integration and Data Architecture**

Design and govern integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems using REST APIs, SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and other supported integration mechanisms.

Define authentication, authorization, API security, error handling, retry mechanisms, monitoring, and integration resiliency.

Lead integration design across identity management, monitoring tools, ERP, CRM, HR, cloud platforms, and other enterprise applications.

Establish data ownership, data mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and validation standards.

Govern CMDB data integrations, identification and reconciliation rules, and data quality where applicable.

Troubleshoot integration failures, authentication issues, data inconsistencies, API errors, and performance constraints.

**5. Platform Governance, Security, and Performance**

Establish platform governance, development lifecycle standards, application access controls, and technical quality gates.

Ensure appropriate use of roles, ACLs, authentication, authorization, encryption, and sensitive-data controls.

Define instance strategy, application scope, update-set or application deployment practices, and environment promotion controls.

Establish release, upgrade, regression-testing, and rollback strategies in collaboration with platform operations.

Assess customization impact on upgrades and minimize upgrade conflicts.

Monitor platform health, transaction performance, script efficiency, integration reliability, and technical debt.

Ensure compliance with enterprise security policies, audit requirements, and applicable governance standards.

**6. CMDB, Service Mapping, and ITOM**

Define CMDB architecture, configuration item classes, relationships, ownership, and data quality controls.

Establish configuration management standards and alignment between business services, technical services, and supporting infrastructure.

Provide architectural guidance for Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and operational visibility where these capabilities are in scope.

Define integration patterns for infrastructure monitoring and service health data.

Ensure that CMDB and operational data support incident impact analysis, change risk assessment, and service availability objectives.

**7. ServiceNow Product and Platform Strategy**

Evaluate and recommend appropriate ServiceNow capabilities across ITSM, ITOM, IT Asset Management, Strategic Portfolio Management, HR Service Delivery, Customer Service Management, Security Operations, and Integrated Risk Management, according to business needs.

Assess product fit, licensing implications, implementation complexity, dependencies, and business value.

Identify opportunities to consolidate fragmented workflows and reduce overlapping tools or custom-built solutions.

Define platform evolution roadmaps, capability maturity improvements, and modernization priorities.

Stay current with relevant ServiceNow releases, platform capabilities, architecture guidance, and recommended practices.

**8. Delivery Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

Partner with business stakeholders, process owners, product managers, project managers, and delivery teams to establish solution scope and technical priorities.

Lead architecture workshops, technical design discussions, proof-of-concept exercises, and solution demonstrations.

Provide technical direction and mentoring to developers, administrators, technical leads, and implementation partners.

Review estimates, technical dependencies, delivery risks, and implementation plans.

Support testing strategy, defect triage, deployment readiness, go-live, and post-production stabilization.

Communicate architectural decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

12–15+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial hands-on ServiceNow experience.

Typically 8+ years of ServiceNow implementation and development experience, including significant ownership of complex technical solutions.

Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade ServiceNow architectures.

Strong knowledge of ITSM processes and ITIL principles; ITIL 4 certification is preferred.

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator certification; relevant implementation and architect-level certifications are strongly preferred.

Strong JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting expertise, including complex debugging and code reviews.

Proven experience with REST/SOAP integrations, authentication, data transformation, and integration troubleshooting.

Experience with platform security, access controls, performance optimization, release management, and upgrades.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

Ability to work independently, make architecture decisions, explain technical trade-offs, and take ownership of complex issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer certification.

Relevant ServiceNow CIS certifications, particularly ITSM and ITOM where applicable.

ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect or Certified Master Architect credentials, where held and relevant to the role.

Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, service management governance, and technical debt reduction.

Experience leading multi-team implementations, platform modernization, and enterprise integration programs.

**Expected Outcomes**

Consistent implementation of ITSM processes aligned with business policies and ITIL principles.

Improved platform stability, integration reliability, maintainability, and upgrade readiness.

### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead SAM Flexera Expert to play a crucial "player\-coach" role within our Software Asset Management (SAM) function. You will architect the end\-to\-end publisher management strategy while actively working as a hands\-on implementor for our most complex, tier\-1 software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive enterprise\-wide continuous cost optimization programs, manually design and configure complex licensing frameworks, serve as the lead technical defender during major vendor audits, and mentor a team of SAM professionals.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Defining the end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier\-1 vendors.
* Acting as the primary authority and hands\-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
* Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise\-wide application rationalization.
* Leading the defense and data strategy during major software vendor audits, collaborating closely with IT Procurement, Legal, and Sourcing teams to mitigate financial risk.
* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
* Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem\-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* 9\+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.
* Proven leadership experience blending end\-to\-end publisher lifecycle strategy with direct, hands\-on platform execution.
* Expert\-level understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, Red Hat, VMware/Broadcom).
* Extensive technical experience managing ecosystem integrations and databases, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, REST APIs, and discovery agent operations.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex licensing data into actionable business strategies for leadership.

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate data management tasks.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

description:
**Role Overview:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and self\-driven IAM Automation and Governance Specialist to enhance and automate our identity and access management (IAM) practices. The role will be primarily focused on integrating Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) with UKG (HRIS) systems, ensuring secure identity lifecycle management aligned with Zero Trust, least privilege, and regulatory compliance (HITRUST, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS).


**Key Responsibilities:**


**Identity \& Access Management:**


* Expert\-level experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)


* Hands\-on with Entitlement Management: Access Packages, Catalogs


* Proficient in Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Access Reviews, Conditional Access


* Automate Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) workflows and user lifecycle events


* Identify and remediate orphaned accounts and over\-permissioned users


* Strong understanding of RBAC and ABAC access control models.


**Scripting \& Automation:**


* Strong proficiency in PowerShell (Graph API, AzureAD, MSOnline, Az modules)


* Ability to automate:


* IAM data exports (e.g., PIM assignments, access packages)


* Sign\-in \& activity log queries


* Provisioning/Deprovisioning tasks


* Knowledge of modular and maintainable scripting best practices


**Security \& Compliance:**


* Understanding of frameworks: NIST 800\-53, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS


* Ability to map IAM controls to compliance framework


* Experience supporting audits through evidence gathering and documentation


**Azure Cloud \& Microsoft Ecosystem:**


* Manage Azure subscriptions, resource groups, and RBAC


* Experience with Intune, Defender for Endpoint, and Company Portal


* Troubleshoot Conditional Access and authentication issues


* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Security \& Compliance Center


**Documentation \& Process Management:**


* Develop SOPs, process flows, and policy documents


* Create and maintain IAM maturity models and strategic roadmaps


* Prepare documentation to support regulatory audits


**Key Competencies:**


* Process Automation: Streamline IAM operations through scripting and workflows


* Security Focus: Deep understanding of IAM security challenges and solutions


* Analytical Thinking: Ability to evaluate and improve access control models


* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Bridge gaps between technical and business functions


* Regulatory Awareness: Strong foundation in data protection, access control standards, and compliance regulations


**Soft Skills:**


* Self\-motivated and capable of working independently


* Strong attention to detail with a security\-first mindset


* Excellent communication skills for technical and non\-technical stakeholders


* Strong collaboration across HR, IT, Security, and DevOps teams


**Education \& Experience:**


* Bachelor's in computer science, Information Security, or related field


* 8–10 years of experience in IAM or IT Security


* Experience integrating Microsoft Entra ID with HRIS platforms (preferably UKG)


* Background in IAM governance and automation in compliance\-heavy environments


**Preferred Certifications:**


* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator


* CISSP / CISM (or equivalent)


* Azure Security Engineer Associate
